load_balancer_id.description: The Load Balancer ID which is used to launch a new listener.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于启动新监听器的负载均衡器ID。
i18n.en-US: The Load Balancer ID which is used to launch a new listener.

backend_port.description: Port used by the Server Load Balancer instance backend.

i18n.zh-Hans: 服务器负载均衡实例后端使用的端口。
i18n.en-US: Port used by the Server Load Balancer instance backend.

frontend_port.description: Port used by the Server Load Balancer instance frontend.

i18n.zh-Hans: 服务器负载均衡器实例前端使用的端口。
i18n.en-US: Port used by the Server Load Balancer instance frontend.
The protocol to listen on.
Bandwidth peak of Listener.

sticky_session.description: Whether to enable session persistence, Valid values are on and off. Default to off.

i18n.zh-Hans: 是否启用会话保持，有效值为开启和关闭。默认为关闭。
i18n.en-US: Whether to enable session persistence, valid values are on and off. Default to off.
Mode for handling the cookie.
Cookie timeout.

cookie.description: The cookie configured on the server.

i18n.en-US: The cookie configured on the server.
Whether to enable health check.

health_check_domain.description: Domain name used for health check.

i18n.en-US: Domain name used for health check.
URI used for health check.
Port used for health check.

healthy_threshold.description: Threshold determining the result of the health check is success.

i18n.zh-Hans: 确定健康检查结果是否成功的阈值。
i18n.en-US: Threshold determining the result of the health check is success.

unhealthy_threshold.description: Threshold determining the result of the health check is fail.

i18n.zh-Hans: 确定健康检查结果的阈值为失败。
i18n.en-US: Threshold determining the result of the health check is fail.

health_check_timeout.description: Maximum timeout of each health check response.

i18n.zh-Hans: 每个健康检查响应的最大超时时间。
i18n.en-US: Maximum timeout of each health check response.
Time interval of health checks.

health_check_http_code.description: Regular health check HTTP status code.

i18n.en-US: Regular health check HTTP status code.

acl_status.description: Whether to enable acl(access control list), the acl is specified by acl_id. Valid values are on and off. Default to off.

i18n.zh-Hans: 是否启用访问控制列表（acl），acl由acl_id指定。有效值为on和off。默认为off。
i18n.en-US: Whether to enable acl (access control list), the acl is specified by acl_id. Valid values are on and off. Default to off.

acl_type.description: Mode for handling the acl specified by acl_id.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于处理由 acl_id 指定的访问控制列表的模式。
i18n.en-US: Mode for handling the ACL specified by acl_id.
